body:
On an open gate, the same text box previously sent either a message or a decision reason. The message box now sends only to its named officer. Choosing a decision opens a separate labelled reason field with Confirm and Cancel; approve allows an empty reason, while revise and hold require one. Each action preserves the other draft.

The discussion names its officer and says it includes other tasks. Decision, confirmation and cancellation targets are at least 44×44 logical pixels. Both layouts use the same composer model; changed targets are refused during asynchronous preflight.

Reviewer guide: `client/co-chat.tsx` presents the two actions; `shared/decision-composer.ts` keeps the in-memory reason and choice separate from the existing message store; `client/decision-card.tsx` binds actions to the current officer and briefing. The relay payload, decision claim/recording path, message footer, draft store, keyboard hook and queue are unchanged.

Validation: `npm test` passes 138 tests; `npm run typecheck` passes. Five named regression tests cover action separation, all three decisions, required reasons, cancel/remount, typing while pending, stale targets, duplicate presses, Enter and Chinese input confirmation. A wrong-reason mutation fails those tests. The rerunnable mounted browser fixture checks 360/1440 layouts, both recipients, retained drafts, actual sends at synthetic SDK boundaries, claim conflicts, failure and measured targets. Evidence is in the workflow state checkout under `r7-one-clear-way-to-decide/evidence/implementation/`, outside this branch.

Flywheel round 7, sixth stack layer, based on PR #54 at `f10a3f29a43fb09adff4beda268799f514f7b43b`. **Draft; do not merge.** No durable reason storage, resend automation, relay/recording change or live installation. Independent validation and team review remain with the First Officer; RoboRev is not run here because the worker sandbox cannot reach its daemon (known package gap 5). The design-surface check is skipped for known package gap 2.
title: [flywheel, do not merge] separate gate messages and decisions
